## My favorite equation

The probability of getting exactly $k$ successes in $n$ independent Bernoulli trials (with the same rate $p$) is given by the probability mass function
$$f(k, n, p) = Pr(X = k) = \binom{n}{k} p^k (1-p)^{n-k}$$
for $k = 0, 1, 2, \dots, n$.
